base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: pixel-art RPG attack sprite sheet. Image 1 is the approved elite knight EQUIPMENT DESIGN ONLY. Image 2 gives this direction's CAMERA AND FACING only; ignore its white slash effects and do NOT copy its low detail. Draw EXACTLY 8 animation frames in a strict FOUR-COLUMN TWO-ROW GRID, equal square cells, read left-to-right top then bottom. One continuous shielded one-handed diagonal sword slash in the SAME direction as image 2 (front three-quarter, shield on image right). Keep identity: closed angular visor helmet, layered asymmetric steel shoulders, fitted chest armor, articulated knees and gauntlets, restrained gold edges, short crimson tabard, medium red heater shield with gold sun, compact sword in anatomical right hand. All frames same character scale and equipment dimensions, fixed camera, screen upper-left light. Detailed clean pixel art suitable for a 120-pixel-tall body, adult 6-head proportions. Inside each square cell: floor baseline at 80% cell height; body helmet-to-feet about 47% cell height; ground center at 50% width. All weapons INSIDE each cell with large margins, no crossing cells. Transparent background, NO ground shadow, NO weapon trails, NO effects, NO grid or labels. Frames: 1 neutral guard, 2 turn shoulder and bend knees starting windup, 3 full sword raised-back windup, 4 fast downward slash passing in front of torso mid-swing, 5 maximum forward-down extension and slight lunge, 6 elbow retracts with sword low, 7 weight settles and sword raises to guard, 8 EXACT SAME guard pose as frame1. Clear changing arm, shoulder and torso mechanics, no duplicated middle poses, no changes of facing, do not rotate character toward another direction. Native high-detail redraw, not scaled old sprite.
